findings.desc: Installation token request was not repository/permission scoped, while response validation required that exact scoped shape.
Rate-limited GitHub 403 responses were classified terminal and could permanently fail an intake delivery.
A notification recovered as outcome_unknown on its final attempt could remain pending forever.
A foreground projection could close and replace an actively composed follow-up intake form.
Unescaped pipes broke the normative GitHub Markdown routing table.
Manual and backend-rendered Issue templates used one schema id with incompatible section structures.

verify.command: backend affected suite: 91 passed, 3 PostgreSQL-only skipped
